experiment: V62 removal-ON/OFF with FaIR-derived harmonized non-CO2 ERF after 2026
common_nonco2_target: fair_matched_nonco2_forcing.csv generated by the FaIR matched-forcing job
implementation: For each carbon branch, Hector FTOT_CONSTRAIN is iterated until RF_TOTAL - RF_CO2 equals the common target for 2027-2300. CO2 forcing remains branch-specific. The numerical solution uses accepted-state adaptive backtracking relaxation. A trial constraint is accepted only when the maximum non-CO2 forcing mismatch decreases. Rejected trials are discarded and retried from the last accepted state with a smaller relaxation factor.
interpretation_boundary: The future non-CO2 forcing contribution is harmonized to FaIR. Hector retains its own carbon-cycle parameters, historical carbon pools, and CO2 forcing formulation. Cross-model disagreement is a result, not an automatic failure gate.
